source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1939, p. 13 ("DOWN COUNTY COUNCIL: Nationalists in Opposition in Warrenpoint")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for the division (Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1939)

note: Triennial election of Down County Council. Only Warrenpoint was contested at the nominations of 3 May 1939, and Mr. Daniel Higgins (Nat.) withdrew there, so all twenty members were returned unopposed; no poll was held (Belfast News-Letter, 4 and 11 May 1939). Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-25 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
